ResourceHeader.ResourceName: IBEX High Energy Neutral Atom Imager (Hi) Data Release 08, Omnidirectional Five-Year Globally Distributed Flux (GDF) ENA Maps, Galactic Coordinates, Level H3

RevisionEvent.Note: Initial release of metadata, ADAPT generated, LFB
Curated and validated against SPASE 2.7.1, OK

ResourceHeader.Description: IBEX-Hi Release 8 five-year globally distributed flux (GDF) component maps derived from the Ribbon/GDF separation using the first five years of IBEX observations (2009-2013). This CDF is identified by its ProductKey as the Galactic-coordinate version of the omnidirectional differential hydrogen ENA flux maps for IBEX-Hi energy channels 2-6, on a 60 by 30 Galactic longitude and latitude grid. Channel 2-6 FWHM energy ranges are 0.52-0.95, 0.84-1.55, 1.36-2.50, 1.99-3.75, and 3.13-6.00 keV; the corresponding nominal energies are 0.71, 1.11, 1.74, 2.73, and 4.29 keV. The CDAWeb ProductKey is IBEX_H3_ENA_HI_R08_OMNI_F3-GDF-MAPS-GALACTIC_5YR.

NumericalData.Caveats: This is a derived globally distributed flux (GDF) component map product from IBEX Release 8, produced by separating the Ribbon from the globally distributed ENA emission. The ProductKey explicitly identifies this as the GALACTIC five-year product; however, the current CDAWeb CDF skeleton for this exact ProductKey retains Solar Ecliptic FIELDNAM, CATDESC, and support-variable labels and describes the logical source as a five-year-average West Ecliptic map. The SPASE display names therefore follow the Galactic product identity while preserving the upstream CDF ParameterKey values and explicitly documenting this metadata inconsistency. SPASE 2.7.1 has no controlled CoordinateSystemName value for Galactic coordinates, so the Galactic frame is recorded textually rather than with a CoordinateSystem element.
